title: Dune: Part Two
overview: Follow the mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a path of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family.
tagline: Long live the fighters.

title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
overview: Miles Morales catapults across the Multiverse, where he encounters a team of Spider-People charged with protecting its very existence.
tagline: It's how you wear the mask that matters.

title: Parasite
overview: All unemployed, Ki-taek's family takes peculiar interest in the wealthy and glamorous Parks for their livelihood until they get entangled in an unexpected incident.
tagline: Act like you own the place.

title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
overview: An aging Chinese immigrant is swept into an insane adventure in which she alone can save what is important to her by connecting with the lives she could have led in other universes.
tagline: The universe is so much bigger than you realize.

title: Inception
overview: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of his targets, is offered a chance to erase his criminal history.
tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.

title: Interstellar
overview: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel.
tagline: Mankind was born on Earth. It was never meant to die here.

title: The Matrix
overview: A computer hacker learns from mysterious rebels about the true nature of his reality and his role in the war against its controllers.
tagline: Welcome to the Real World.

title: Oppenheimer
overview: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer's role in the development of the atomic bomb.
tagline: The world forever changes.

title: Deadpool & Wolverine
overview: A listless Wade Wilson toils away in civilian life with his days as the morally flexible mercenary, Deadpool, behind him.
tagline: Come together.

title: Dune
overview: Paul Atreides, a brilliant and gifted young man born into a great destiny beyond his understanding, must travel to the most dangerous planet in the universe.
tagline: Beyond fear, destiny awaits.

title: The Batman
overview: When a sadistic serial killer begins murdering key political figures in Gotham, Batman is forced to investigate the city's hidden corruption and question his family's involvement.
tagline: It's not just a signal; it's a warning.

title: Gladiator II
overview: Years after witnessing the revered hero Maximus's death, Lucius is forced to enter the Colosseum after his home is conquered by the tyrannical Emperors.
tagline: The legacy of his father begins.

title: The Incredibles
overview: Bob Parr has given up his superhero days to log in time as an insurance adjuster and raise his three children with his formerly heroic wife in suburbia.
tagline: No gut, no glory.

title: The Departed
overview: To take down South Boston's Irish Mafia, the police send in one of their own to infiltrate the underworld, not realizing the syndicate has done likewise.
tagline: Cops or criminals. When you're facing a loaded gun, what's the difference?

title: The Wolf of Wall Street
overview: A New York stockbroker refuses to cooperate in a large securities fraud case involving corruption on Wall Street, corporate banking and mob infiltration.
tagline: Earn. Spend. Party.

title: The Truman Show
overview: Truman Burbank is the unwitting star of a 24-hour-a-day reality TV show that broadcasts every aspect of his life without his knowledge.
tagline: On the air. Unaware.

title: The Pianist
overview: The true story of pianist Władysław Szpilman's experiences in Warsaw during the Nazi occupation.
tagline: Music was his passion. Survival was his masterpiece.

title: The Terminal
overview: An eastern European tourist becomes stranded at JFK Airport when a coup d'état erupts in his homeland, leaving him unable to enter the United States or return home.
tagline: Life is waiting.

title: The Da Vinci Code
overview: A murder in the Louvre and cryptic clues in Leonardo da Vinci's paintings lead to the discovery of a religious mystery.
tagline: Seek the truth.

title: The Usual Suspects
overview: Held in an L.A. interrogation room, Verbal Kint attempts to convince the authorities that a legendary crime lord was responsible for a deadly heist.
tagline: Five criminals. One line up. No coincidence.

title: The Big Lebowski
overview: A laid-back Los Angeles slacker is mistaken for a millionaire with the same name and becomes entangled in a bizarre kidnapping scheme.
tagline: They figured he was a lazy, time-wasting slacker. They were right.

title: The Revenant
overview: In the 1820s, a frontiersman sets out on a path of vengeance against those who left him for dead after a bear attack.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
overview: Two imprisoned men bond over a number of years, finding solace and eventual redemption through acts of common decency.
tagline: Fear can hold you prisoner. Hope can set you free.

title: The Godfather
overview: The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty transfers control of his clandestine empire to his reluctant son.
tagline: An offer you can't refuse.

title: Pulp Fiction
overview: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster and his wife intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption.
tagline: Just because you are a character doesn't mean you have character.

title: The Dark Knight
overview: Batman faces a criminal mastermind known as the Joker, who plunges Gotham City into chaos.
tagline: Welcome to a world without rules.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
overview: Gandalf and Aragorn lead the World of Men against Sauron's army as Frodo and Sam approach Mount Doom.
tagline: The eye of the enemy is moving.

title: Fight Club
overview: An insomniac office worker and a soap-making anarchist form an underground fight club that evolves into something much more.
tagline: Mischief. Mayhem. Soap.

title: GoodFellas
overview: The story of Henry Hill and his life in the mob, covering his relationship with his wife Karen and his partners Jimmy and Tommy.
tagline: Three decades of life in the mafia.

title: Forrest Gump
overview: The presidencies of Kennedy and Johnson, the Vietnam War, Watergate and other historical events unfold through the perspective of an Alabama man with a low IQ.
tagline: The world will never be the same once you've seen it through the eyes of Forrest Gump.

title: Se7en
overview: Two detectives hunt a serial killer who uses the seven deadly sins as his motives.
tagline: Seven deadly sins. Seven ways to die.

title: The Silence of the Lambs
overview: A young FBI cadet must confide in an imprisoned and manipulative killer to receive his help catching another serial killer.
tagline: To enter the mind of a killer she must challenge the mind of a madman.

title: Spirited Away
overview: A young girl enters a world ruled by gods, witches and spirits where humans are changed into beasts.
tagline: On the other side of the tunnel was a mysterious town.

title: Django Unchained
overview: With the help of a German bounty hunter, a freed slave sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal Mississippi plantation owner.
tagline: Life, liberty and the pursuit of vengeance.

title: Back to the Future
overview: Marty McFly accidentally travels back to 1955 and must make sure his parents fall in love before he can return to his own time.
tagline: He's the only kid ever to get into trouble before he was born.

title: The Shining
overview: A family heads to an isolated hotel for the winter where a sinister and supernatural presence influences the father into violence.
tagline: A masterpiece of modern horror.

title: Alien
overview: The crew of a commercial spacecraft encounter a deadly lifeform after investigating an unknown transmission.
tagline: In space no one can hear you scream.

title: Schindler's List
overview: A German industrialist gradually becomes concerned for his Jewish workforce after witnessing the persecution of Jews during World War II.
tagline: Whoever saves one life, saves the world entire.

title: 12 Angry Men
overview: A dissenting juror in a murder trial forces the jury to reconsider the evidence before them.
tagline: Life is in their hands. Death is on their minds!

title: The Godfather Part II
overview: The early life and career of Vito Corleone in 1920s New York is portrayed while his son Michael expands and strengthens the family crime business.
tagline: I don't feel I have to wipe everybody out, Tom. Just my enemies.

title: The Green Mile
overview: A prison guard discovers that a gentle giant on death row possesses a mysterious gift.
tagline: Miracles happen in places you least expect.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
overview: A meek Hobbit and eight companions set out on a journey to destroy the powerful One Ring and save Middle-earth.
tagline: One ring to rule them all.

title: The Social Network
overview: The story of the founding of Facebook and the lawsuits that followed its explosive growth.
tagline: You don't get to 500 million friends without making a few enemies.

title: Her
overview: A lonely writer develops an unlikely relationship with an advanced operating system designed to meet his every need.
tagline: A story about love and technology.

title: Ex Machina
overview: A young programmer is invited to administer a Turing test to an advanced humanoid artificial intelligence.
tagline: To erase the line between man and machine is to obscure the line between men and gods.

title: Prisoners
overview: When his daughter and her friend disappear, a desperate father takes matters into his own hands while a detective searches for answers.
tagline: Every moment matters.

title: Gone Girl
overview: A man's wife disappears on their fifth wedding anniversary, causing suspicion and media scrutiny to fall on him.
tagline: You don't know what you've got till it's gone.

title: Arrival
overview: A linguist is recruited by the military to communicate with mysterious extraterrestrial visitors who have arrived around the world.
tagline: Why are they here?

title: Blade Runner 2049
overview: A young blade runner uncovers a long-buried secret that leads him to track down former LAPD blade runner Rick Deckard.
tagline: The key to the future is finally unearthed.

title: The Martian
overview: An astronaut stranded on Mars must rely on his ingenuity to survive while NASA and his crewmates attempt to bring him home.
tagline: Bring him home.

title: Jojo Rabbit
overview: A young German boy discovers that his mother is hiding a Jewish girl in their attic during World War II.
tagline: Meet a little Hitler.

title: Whiplash
overview: A young jazz drummer enrolls at a prestigious music conservatory where his ambitious instructor pushes him toward perfection.
tagline: The road to greatness can take you to the edge.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
overview: A legendary concierge and his young lobby boy become involved in the theft of a priceless painting and a battle over a family fortune.
tagline: A murder. A theft. A romantic affair.

title: The Prestige
overview: Two rival magicians engage in a bitter battle to create the ultimate illusion, with devastating consequences.
tagline: Are you watching closely?
